Batch 5 is merged into `michael/dev`: 12 more modules now have a `doc/architecture.md`, bringing the census to 66 of 113.

The 12 modules are `ext/Mention`, `ui/panel`, `ext/System`, `ui/table`, `ui/timeline`, `ui/toolbar`, `core/Section`, `ext/catalog`, `ui/accordion`, `ext/toc`, `ui/avatar` and `ui/badge`. Each doc is under 80 lines and each minion checked it against the code. Each module's readme "More" line links to it, and so does its `doc/files.jsonl`. The log's landing line has a plain title, but I only checked `tail -1` before committing the log, not after. No module has more than 10 importers now, so this batch ran past the "3+ importers" cutoff in the brief. I also skipped `ux/Dictate`, since the minion brief says not to touch it.

The light review gave 5 notes. I fixed three: the missing `files.jsonl` entries for `ui/badge`, `ui/panel` and `ui/toolbar`, the stale "Stub" lines in the panel and timeline readmes, and one "the owner's rule" wording in the `ext/System` doc. I noted two, since both are code gaps outside this fence:
- **`ext/System`:** `heal_limit` is declared but never read, so no cap is enforced.
- **`ext/toc`:** `toc.css` is not ASCII-only, against the rule in its own decisions doc.

I didn't touch any `page.js`, so none of the new docs is in a `notes:` list.
